lines.text: Excuse me, is the gallery near this station?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Yes, but the front door is on Garden Lane.
lines.speaker: Owen

lines.text: Which exit should I use for Garden Lane?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Use exit two. Turn left at the small bookshop.
lines.speaker: Owen

lines.text: My bag is heavy. Can I take a bus instead?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Yes, take bus nine from exit one. Get off at Garden Lane.
lines.speaker: Owen

lines.text: Does that stop put me near the front door?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Yes, it's right across from the front door.
lines.speaker: Owen
